scope: Review current Stage 16A implementation and both correction rounds. Preserve current changes; no later stage, release, commit or push.

findings.title: Native admission accepts incompatible nested thinking that converters omit
findings.observed: OpenAI with Anthropic signed nested thinking, and Anthropic with OpenAI encrypted nested thinking: both report compacted; actual SDK count/compact bodies omit thinking text and opaque data. Exact source archive remains intact. Matching-provider nested-thinking controls retain those fields.

findings.title: Explicit compactContext bypasses the preservation hook and compaction events
findings.observed: With automatic:false, manual native compaction completes once but beforeCompaction, compaction:starting and context:compacted each run zero times; the preservation note is absent. Equivalent automatic control runs the hook/events once and preserves the note.

findings.title: Forced Anthropic compaction output limit conflicts with valid fixed thinking
findings.observed: Same Agent config thinking {enabled:true,mode:enabled,budgetTokens:8192} completes ordinary managed run with max_tokens:64000. compactContext counts and archives its text source, then locally throws thinking budgetTokens must be at least 1024 and less than max_output_tokens (4096), before native HTTP. Adaptive and 2048-token fixed-thinking controls compact successfully.
